The retreat follows a historic rally in which the S&P 500 gained 4.7%, the Nasdaq jumped 6.5% and the Dow advanced 3%, ending a seven-session losing streak for the S&P 500. Nvidia is back under pressure after surging 31% Monday, adding nearly $1T to its market capitalization. Shares are down approximately 4% pre-market, while Micron, AMD and Marvell are also declining.
